```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
MortalityData<- read.csv("../data/mortality_clean.csv")
mortalityCount<- MortalityData%>%
  mutate(death_count=1)%>%
  select(park, death_cause, age_range, death_count)%>%
  group_by(park, death_cause, age_range) %>%
  summarize(death_count, .groups = "drop")%>%
  ungroup()

datatable(mortalityCount, options = list(pageLength = 5))

```

```{r}
mortalityCount<- MortalityData %>%
  group_by(park, death_cause, age_range)%>%
  summarize(deaths = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  group_by(park)%>%
  mutate(total_deaths= sum(deaths))

datatable(mortalityCount, options = list(pageLength = 5))
```
